answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 8789 Country: India Title: What is a significant of Haqeeqah (For new born baby)? Question: What is a significant of Haqeeqah (For new born baby)? Answer ID: 8789 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1083/1083=M/1429) It is sunnah to observe aqiqah of newborn baby. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) performed the aqiqah of his grandchildren (Hadhrat Hasan and Hadhrat Hussain). By aqiqah , the troubles go away from the baby and it is protected against problems. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
